guardrails: Math has no writes or implied approvals in Decision, MCDM, AURA or dw.tools.
Only observed RS050 local-package hashes are recorded; any transferred/rebuilt binary must be reidentified and independently verified.
Request drafts are not transmitted and no recipient acceptance or regression run is claimed.
Preserve 1.x APIs and domain rules; any incompatible proposed cutover belongs to the owning agent and may need an explicit major version.
Do not imply cryptographic security, VaR/CVaR policy, PROMETHEE ranking equivalence or neutral dw.discovery admission.
